sam (CSM): sharing a tiny customer-facing 'rapid onboard' checklist for days 0-7. one pager, copyable into kickoff email.

ivy (CS Ops): perfect. include clear 'if X -> do Y' lines.

sam (CSM): pasted below. short and prescriptive.

---
Rapid Onboard: Day 0-7 Checks (paste)
1) Keys & region: confirm project key, pick nearest region.
2) Baseline: run 60s smoke test at expected rps; capture p50/p95.
3) Cache: enable prefix cache (TTL 10-20s). if repeated prompts, raise TTL.
4) Batch: start max_batch=6, max_wait_ms=20. drop batch size if tail latency jumps.
5) Stream: ensure client supports reconnect + final-chunk fallback.
6) Signals: flag if p95 rises >30% for 48h OR weekly active users drop >12%.
7) Quick fixes: if p95 spike -> reduce batch / enable cache; if streams fail -> use non-stream fallback.
8) Escalate: tag @ivy for CS ops, @drew for tuning, @mike for infra.
---

drew (Eng): tiny command to estimate token cost included in enablement doc.
